name: runpin-measurements
description: 자기소개서용 개선 전후 측정 스크립트. 앱 빌드와 무관하며 measurements 브랜치에만 존재한다.

scripts.m1: node make-pipeline.js && node measure1.js && node agg1.js
scripts.m4:emulator: npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore "npx vitest run rules/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.m4b: for v in v1-7a3f09c v2-naive-open v3-final v4-proposed; do SUITE=rules/likes.test.mjs RULES=rules/$v.rules npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-runpin-likes "npx vitest run --reporter=json --outputFile=result-emulator-likes-$v.json"; done && node agg-likes.js
scripts.m4b:gap: SUITE=rules/likes-gap.test.mjs RULES=rules/v3-final.rules npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-runpin-gap "npx vitest run --reporter=basic"
